decision_boundary_statistics.score_semantics: LinearSVC decision scores are signed decision-function values, not calibrated probabilities. Values are comparable only within the same fitted estimator and class-score context.

reproduction_checks.reference_limitation: Committed evaluation reports contain exact aggregate metrics and confusion matrices but no ordered per-example labels. Labels are reproduced from hash-pinned artifacts and checked against their decision outputs; ordered hashes are frozen in this report.

hypothesis_assessment.hypothesis: unsupported_or_uncertain may be heterogeneous for one binary supported-vs-unsupported boundary

candidate_categories.interpretation: Lane-level outcome differences may motivate future human review of whether the unsupported label contains coherent subgroups; they do not establish new intents.
The observed protected errors may inform future review of action-state and context boundaries; they do not authorize a new V2-C4 model or runtime behavior.
